scope: living/current-facing project claims only; historical versioned release notes and validation reports remain period-correct

policy.open: still not claimed as exact/implemented/currently validated
policy.resolved: formerly open item with later evidence or implementation; historical mentions do not make it current
policy.human_decision: not a technical reverse-engineering blocker and not to be auto-resolved

open_boundaries.claim: The recovered Visualizer RGB recurrence is exact, and WIP178 hardware footage shows clear RGB remains visible with BG:A=0; Canvas2D is still not claimed bit-identical to Xenos render-target alpha storage/compositing or final presentation.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires a more exact Xenos render-target/alpha observation or an equivalent controlled runtime capture; do not infer it from Canvas behavior.

open_boundaries.claim: Raw BGM semantics, Check Mode direct transfer, normal-stage adaptive VOL SCALE normalization and the native Xbox 360 processing window are recovered. WIP174 fixes one XAudio2 processing pass at 5 1/3 ms = 256 samples at 48 kHz. Only browser/native analyser snapshot phase and scheduling remain approximate.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires controlled sample-phase/runtime instrumentation only if exact Web Audio snapshot alignment to native XAudio2 quantum boundaries is required; native quantum duration/window size itself is resolved.

open_boundaries.claim: Normal-stage XmapW_S and map4_/map5_ route filenames deterministically map to levelW_stageS.dat. Explicit Bmap13/Bmap15 DAT playback now cross-checks authored WARNING[12]/WARNING[14] request compatibility and reports request frames/competing special requests. Canonical Bmap ownership and the gameplay route-object initialization/instantiation frame remain explicit rather than inferred.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs scene-level/canonical ownership evidence for Bmap boss/special routes and exact route-object initialization timing; normal-stage filename correspondence and explicit Bmap WARNING-request compatibility no longer block playback.

open_boundaries.claim: SCROLL_01/02/03 are proven layer 0/1/2 X/Y velocity setters; player-facing layer names remain unresolved.
open_boundaries.blocker: Naming only; no behavior is blocked.

open_boundaries.claim: True multi-joint/blended glTF weights remain rejected because the checked retail player/enemy corpus has 901 MESH records at skin_index 0xFFFF and no JOINT/WEIGHT ARRY semantics.
open_boundaries.blocker: No native weighted-skin representation has been evidenced; do not invent one.

open_boundaries.claim: MESH.skin_index is understood only for the repeated observed 0xFFFF no-vertex-skin case; non-0xFFFF semantics are not claimed.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs a genuine native sample or executable consumer using another value.

open_boundaries.claim: The toolkit can preserve/synthesize proven shader metadata, and targeted Visualizer shader semantics have been decoded, but it does not compile new Xenos/RSX shader microcode.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires a separately justified platform shader compiler/assembler path and runtime validation.

open_boundaries.claim: Remaining unnamed GMX/root fields are preserved in template mode or explicitly defaulted/overridden in canonical synthesis without invented meanings.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs additional executable or corpus evidence per field.

open_boundaries.claim: Multi-bone MOTN/ANIM tracks are supported, but no native named animation-clip container has been proven.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs a name-bearing native animation container/consumer; glTF clip names remain provenance only.

open_boundaries.claim: Template-free GMX construction is structurally implemented, but retail runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes is not claimed from source-only tests.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires controlled Xenia/console/devkit validation on representative original scenes.

open_boundaries.claim: Canonical donor-free TEX synthesis covers the proven uncompressed layouts; compressed or mipmapped authoring variants are not implemented as a general path.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs format-specific layout evidence plus encode/runtime tests for each variant.

open_boundaries.claim: PS3 canonical A8R8G8B8 TEX synthesis round-trips structurally, while runtime acceptance of unknown wrapper fields for newly invented textures remains an emulator/hardware gate.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires PS3 runtime validation of genuinely new synthesized textures.

open_boundaries.claim: SIIG SDAT decryption/authentication is implemented, but generation of a signed/encrypted replacement NPDRM/SDAT wrapper is not.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires a legally/technically justified re-encryption/signing implementation; inner BBX rebuild remains available.

open_boundaries.claim: Mod Workspace supports variable-duration/rate Xbox XWB PCM16 replacement with metadata/loop-region rewrite and flexible channel input, plus variable-duration/rate PS3 SBlk repacking with multichannel-input downmix to SIIG native mono. Native XMA2 re-encoding, true multichannel PS3 topology synthesis, and retail-runtime acceptance remain open.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs controlled emulator/hardware validation of edited Xbox/PS3 banks; optional native XMA2 encoding and true multichannel/topology-changing PS3 bank synthesis remain separate implementation work.

open_boundaries.claim: Blender add-on source regressions are covered, but an in-Blender UI/operator runtime validation remains external to the release-build environment.
open_boundaries.blocker: Requires running the add-on in a supported Blender environment.

open_boundaries.claim: The Android/iOS Level-9 authored-content split is mapped, but the exact rationale for Android placeholder scripts selecting one V2 boss opcode each remains unresolved.
open_boundaries.blocker: Historical mobile rationale; no current extraction/build feature depends on it.

open_boundaries.claim: The runtime generated-layer capacity doubling is resolved (iOS 0x1800 -> PS3 retail 0x3000 per layer), but the authoring/design rationale for the console generator MAP corpus having exactly 2x iOS total stored cells remains unresolved.
open_boundaries.blocker: Needs per-file authored-dimension lineage, source-level design intent, or equivalent evidence explaining why console resources were expanded; allocator mechanics are no longer the blocker.

resolved_superseded_boundaries.resolution: Resolved in dev17 as Evolution Tree stage-node status bytes; dev16 unresolved wording is historical.
Retail non-loop fixed-spacing route resampler, classifier, six-state tangents and cubic Hermite evaluation are implemented and regression-covered.
Canonical template-free GMX root/scene synthesis is implemented.
Donor-free MESH/ARRY vertex declarations and MTRL parameter streams are implemented structurally.
Multi-bone glTF clips and CUBICSPLINE TRS import are implemented.
Canonical Xbox 360 and PS3 TEX wrapper synthesis is implemented for the proven layouts.
Retail camera preset word 11 is recovered as face_bias.
Recursive feedback sampler is recovered as repeat + point min/mag/mip with anisotropy disabled.
All ten serialized Visualizer SHAPE samplers are recovered as repeat + point filtering with anisotropy disabled.
EffectBlur fixed-function blend is recovered as Add(SrcAlpha, One).
EffectBlur pixel shader is recovered as feedback RGB sample with uniform source alpha.
ScreenSprite SHAPE shader is recovered as sampled RGBA times runtime float4 tint, source-over blended.

Retail Xbox 360 and PS3 stage-placement transform consumption proves row-vector S * Rz(z) * Rx(x) * Ry(y) * T. Stage Explorer applies the recovered runtime scale, stored degree rotations, and placement origin to GMX root-AABB proxy corners.

WIP161 implements clean-room mono PCM16 -> PS-ADPCM encoding and fixed-capacity SBlk slot replacement while preserving bank layout and original per-frame control bytes; broader audio authoring remains open.

PS3 retail stageGenerateMapInit (0x001327E8) allocates three generated MAP layers using capacity factors 0x20,0x20,0x20 multiplied by 0x180, yielding 0x3000 (12,288) bytes per layer; stageGenerate2DMap append logic at 0x001329DC bounds writes against the same product. The retained iOS ancestor capacity is 0x1800 (6,144) bytes per layer, so the runtime output capacity doubled exactly 2x.

WIP164 explicitly cross-checks Bmap13/Bmap15 caller-supplied DATs for the proven WARNING[12]/WARNING[14] special-resource requests, reports authored request frame(s), competing special requests and normalized reload frame 130, while keeping canonical DAT ownership and route-object initialization timing uninferred.

WIP167 recovers the normal-stage post-meter path: constructor default 300-frame adaptive buffer, ScriptVOLUME_SCALE/opcode 0xCE reconfiguration (minimum 5; stages 4-2/4-4/4-5 author 180), exact MIN/MAX and 0.001-span guard, VOL SCALE mapping, and 180-frame RAW/SCALE diagnostic histories. Dedicated Check Mode remains a raw-meter path. Real-hardware overlay values numerically cross-check the formula.

WIP173 recovers VL_CHANGETIME as SequenceSet row-change timing, not parameter interpolation: default 18000-frame bounds, authored [min,max) threshold selection, exact Microsoft CRT LCG/rand30 construction, strict threshold<counter advance condition, -1/end wrap to slot 0, and next-update parameter application. Native seed remains timer-derived, so the browser exposes an explicit deterministic simulation seed rather than claiming a captured hardware seed.

WIP178 project-owner model identification resolves emy_051 as LUST; WIP179 synchronizes the living boundary registry. Runtime 0x9D -> emy_051 ownership remains executable-backed across all five retained builds. No executable-internal LUST string/token is claimed, but that provenance distinction no longer requires a neutral player-facing label.

human_decisions.claim: No project license is selected; this remains an owner publication decision, not a reverse-engineering uncertainty.
Passing WIP gates does not automatically seal/promote dev24.

audit_rules: Historical versioned release notes and validation reports may retain period-correct unresolved statements.
Current-facing docs must not cite a resolved_superseded boundary as still open.
An open boundary may be closed only by evidence, implementation plus validation where applicable, or an explicit owner decision for human_decisions.
Opaque GPU/GMX state must not be guessed to reduce this list.
